illustration.description: Cartoon-style illustration of a young boy with messy brown hair and a worried, slightly frowning expression, wearing a blue hoodie with white drawstrings and a front pocket, gray jeans rolled at the ankles, and blue sneakers. He stands with feet wide apart and arms slightly out at his sides, body swaying, with small motion arcs near his hands and hips. Soft blue ground shadow beneath his feet. Clean hand-drawn outline style with gentle flat colors and subtle paper-like texture on an off-white background, soft even lighting, centered composition.

graphics.description: Thin yellow-orange curved arrow pointing left near the lower left of the figure, indicating sway
Thin yellow-orange curved arrow pointing right near the lower right of the figure, indicating sway
Thick hand-drawn yellow underline stroke beneath the BALANCE ADAPTING text, slightly curved
Soft blue elliptical ground shadow under the feet
